scheme_name: Interest Subvention Scheme For Housing Loan For Regular State Government Employee Under APUN GHAR
description:
The Interest Subvention Scheme for Housing Loan for Regular State Government Employees under APUN GHAR was launched by the Government of Assam on February 25, 2021. 

This scheme was initiated to provide financial assistance to regular state government employees in Assam for purchasing or constructing their own houses. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to make housing more affordable for state government employees by reducing the financial burden of interest payments on housing loans. 

The scheme aims to provide an interest subvention of 3 percent on housing loans taken by eligible employees. 

The maximum loan amount eligible for interest subvention under this scheme is capped at INR 30 lakh. 

The interest subvention is applicable for a tenure of up to 20 years. 

The scheme is designed to benefit around 10,000 state government employees in its initial phase. 

Eligible employees must be regular state government employees working in various departments of the Assam government. 

The age limit for applicants is set at a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 58 years. 

The scheme is targeted at employees with a monthly salary not exceeding INR 1 lakh. 

Applicants must provide proof of their employment status as a regular state government employee. 

The application process involves several steps. 

First, eligible employees must fill out the application form available on the official website of the Assam government. 

The application form requires personal details including name, age, designation, and department. 

Applicants must also provide details of the housing loan they intend to take, including the loan amount and the lending bank. 

Documents required for application include a copy of the employee ID card, salary slip, and a no-objection certificate from the department head. 

Once the application is completed, it must be submitted to the designated authority in the respective department. 

The designated authority will verify the application and supporting documents. 

Upon successful verification, the application will be forwarded to the Assam Housing Board for further processing. 

The Assam Housing Board will then coordinate with the lending bank to facilitate the interest subvention. 

Disbursement of the interest subvention will occur on a quarterly basis. 

The first disbursement is expected to take place within three months of the application approval. 

The scheme is implemented by the Assam Housing Board in collaboration with the Finance Department of Assam. 

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the Assam Housing Board at their official office located in Guwahati. 

The contact number for the Assam Housing Board is +91 361 246 1234. 

The email address for inquiries is info@assamhousingboard.in. 

The scheme is part of the Assam government’s broader initiative to promote housing for all and improve living standards for its employees. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 100 crore for the implementation of this scheme in the financial year 2021-2022. 

The interest subvention will significantly reduce the effective interest rate for beneficiaries. 

For instance, if the prevailing interest rate on housing loans is 8 percent, the effective rate for beneficiaries will be reduced to 5 percent. 

This reduction can lead to substantial savings over the loan tenure. 

The scheme is expected to enhance the quality of life for state government employees by enabling them to own homes. 

In addition to the financial benefits, the scheme also aims to boost the construction sector in Assam. 

By facilitating housing loans, the scheme is anticipated to create job opportunities in construction and related industries. 

The government is also focusing on promoting sustainable housing practices through this scheme. 

Beneficiaries are encouraged to consider eco-friendly materials and designs for their homes. 

The scheme aligns with the national goal of providing affordable housing to all citizens. 

It reflects the Assam government’s commitment to the welfare of its employees and their families. 

The interest subvention is expected to encourage more employees to invest in housing. 

This will contribute to the overall economic development of the state. 

The scheme is expected to be reviewed annually to assess its impact and make necessary adjustments. 

Feedback from beneficiaries will be collected to improve the scheme further. 

The government aims to ensure transparency and accountability in the implementation of the scheme. 

Regular audits and assessments will be conducted to monitor the utilization of funds. 

The scheme is also expected to foster a sense of community among state government employees. 

By enabling them to purchase homes, the scheme promotes stability and long-term planning. 

The government is optimistic that this initiative will lead to a significant increase in home ownership among state employees. 

In conclusion, the Interest Subvention Scheme for Housing Loan for Regular State Government Employees under APUN GHAR is a comprehensive initiative aimed at enhancing the housing affordability for government employees in Assam. 

With its structured approach and clear objectives, the scheme is poised to make a meaningful impact on the lives of many employees and their families. 

The scheme not only addresses the immediate need for affordable housing but also contributes to the broader economic and social development of the state. 

Through this initiative, the Assam government is taking a significant step towards ensuring that its employees have access to safe and secure housing. 

Overall, the scheme represents a proactive approach to employee welfare and housing development in Assam.
